author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
LEGO and Pokémon are finally releasing sets featuring some of the franchise's iconic pocket monsters. The three sets will feature Pikachu, Eevee, and a mega set with Charizard, Blastoise, and Venusaur. However, the sets will cost you—$59.99 for Eevee, $199.99 for Pikachu, and a whopping $649.99 for the triple set. In other news, The Division could be getting a definitive edition 10 years after it first released. The game has already seen a sequel, with a third main entry and a mobile game on the way. And finally, Avatar: Fire and Ash has made more than $1 billion in theaters, which has pushed Zoe Saldaña ito the top of A-list box office earners, surpassing previous record-holder (and fellow MCU alumn) Scarlett Johansson.
title: LEGO Pokémon Sets Revealed, Here's How Much It'll Cost To Catch 'Em All - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Misdirection trailer for this upcoming action thriller movie starring Frank Grillo (Superman, Avengers: Endgame), Olga Kurylenko (Black Widow, Quantum of Solace) and Oliver Trevena (The Gorge, Plane).

Misdirection follows a couple driven to carry out a series of high-end heists to pay off a dangerous mob debt. When their latest break-in — targeting a prominent defense attorney — spirals out of control, the pair find themselves caught in a web of secrets, deception, and deadly consequences.

Misdirection, directed by Kevin Lewis (Willy’s Wonderland), will debut on Digital and Video on Demand on February 10, 2026.
title: Misdirection - Official Trailer (2026) Frank Grillo, Olga Kurylenko

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Teaser Trailer for Lee Cronin’s The Mummy, an upcoming horror film distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures. Witness an endearing reunion shift into a nightmare in Lee Cronin’s The Mummy, in theaters on April 17.

The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

Lee Cronin’s The Mummy stars Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy, Natalie Grace, with Veronica Falcón. The film is written and directed by Cronin, and produced by James Wan, Jason Blum and John Keville. The executive producers are Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Macdara Kelleher and Lee Cronin. 

Lee Cronin’s The Mummy is in theaters on April 17.

#LeeCroninsTheMummy #Movies #IGN
title: Lee Cronin’s The Mummy - Official Teaser Trailer (2026) Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy

author: IGN
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Masters of Albion! A brand new entry in the "God game" genre, developed by 22Cans and headed up by Peter Molyneux! 

Masters of Albion expands the genre in exciting new ways, allowing you to fully build up your village and villagers, wield awesome power to inspire, or terrify your populous, and even posses the body of a hero or animal to defend your people and their home against the forces of the night! 

During the day, as your villagers toil and build your village into a modern industrial force, at night the powers of magic seek to grip your village and drag it back to a darker age of magic. 

Masters of Albion launches on PC (Steam) April 22nd. 2026!

#IGN #MastersOfAlbion #GodGame
title: Masters of Albion - Official Release Date Trailer

description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for TR-49, an investigative narrative deduction game developed by Inkle Ltd. Players will interact with a World War 2-era computer filled with journals, letters, and secrets to find by decoding specific codes. Navigate the computer's storage through puzzle solving, trial and error, and more to find a book capable of rewriting the world before time runs out. TR-49 is launching on January 21 for iOS and PC (Steam).
